name: Rogue Wear by Southern Oregon Embroidery
description: We are a family owned business in Downtown Medford, OR who love all things camping and outdoors. It all started 13 years ago out of our home shop, where we did embroidery jobs for local schools, businesses, etc. Years later, we were inspired after visiting family in Texas. We noticed how many people wore Texas clothing and thought "well, we're pretty proud of how beautiful our state is too!" Our youngest, Mateo, immediately started sketching designs. February of 2017, we opened our first storefront where we formed wonderful friendships with our customers. Because of our amazing customers and friends, we eventually outgrew the space and expanded in November of 2021. We have been able to expand our own clothing line as well as bringing in other Oregon and PNW small businesses. Oregon is truly a beautiful place to draw inspiration from and we're so thankful to have a space to showcase our love for it.
